Source / Video processing

video.ffmpeg.testsrc​

ffmpeg's test source video (useful for testing and debugging).

Type:

(?id : string) -> source('a)

Synchronization:

This source paces its clock while connected when self_sync is true.

Composition:

This source uses live composition by default.

Arguments:

  • id (of type string, which defaults to "video.testsrc")

Methods:

  • buffered (of type () -> [string * float]): Length of buffered data.
  • callbacks_count (of type () -> [string * int]): Callbacks a script has registered on this source, as pairs of callback name and count. A count that keeps growing is a function registering on a source it is handed without releasing what it registered.
  • clear_last_metadata (of type () -> unit): Clear the last metadata from the source.
  • clock (of type clock): The source's clock
  • duration (of type () -> float): Estimation of the duration of the current track.
  • elapsed (of type () -> float): Elapsed time in the current track.
  • fallible (of type bool): Indicate if a source may fail, i.e. may not be ready to stream.
  • generate_frame (of type () -> unit): Generate a frame from the source without consuming it. This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. You should make sure that the source is available before calling this function and it should only be called inside synchronous streaming loop callback such as on_frame!
  • id (of type () -> string): Identifier of the source.
  • insert_metadata (of type (?override : bool, ?new_track : bool, [string * string]) -> unit): Dynamically insert metadata in a stream. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.
  • is_active (of type () -> bool): true if the source is active, i.e. it is continuously animated by its own clock whenever it is ready. Typically, true for outputs and sources such as input.http.
  • is_ready (of type () -> bool): Indicate if a source is ready to stream. This does not mean that the source is currently streaming, just that its resources are all properly initialized.
  • is_started (of type () -> bool): true if the output or source is started.
  • is_up (of type () -> bool): Indicate that the source can be asked to produce some data at any time. This is true when the source is currently being used or if it could be used at any time, typically inside a switch or fallback.
  • last_metadata (of type () -> [string * string]?): Return the last metadata from the source.
  • log (of type {level : (() -> int).{exchange : (int) -> int, set : (int) -> unit}}): Get or set the source's log level, from 1 to 5.
  • register_command (of type (?usage : string?, description : string, string, ((string) -> string)) -> unit): Register a server command for this source. Command is registered under the source's id namespace when it gets up and de-registered when it gets down.
  • remaining (of type () -> float): Estimation of remaining time in the current track.
  • reset_last_metadata_on_track (of type (() -> bool).{exchange : (bool) -> bool, set : (bool) -> unit}): If true, the source's last_metadata is reset on each new track. If a metadata is present along with the track mark, then it becomes the new last_metadata, otherwise, last_metadata becomes null`.
  • seek (of type (float) -> float): Seek forward, in seconds (returns the amount of time effectively seeked).
  • self_sync (of type () -> bool): Is the source currently controlling its own real-time loop.
  • self_sync_description (of type () -> string): This source paces its clock while connected when self_sync is true.
  • set_url (of type ({string}) -> unit): Set the URL, used at the next connection.
  • skip (of type () -> unit): Skip to the next track.
  • start (of type () -> unit): Ask the source or output to start.
  • status (of type () -> string): Status: "stopped", "starting", "polling", "connected <url>", "stopping" or "failed".
  • stop (of type () -> unit): Ask the source or output to stop.
  • time (of type () -> float): Get a source's time, based on its assigned clock.
  • url (of type () -> string): Current URL.

Callbacks:

  • on_collect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source is collected
  • on_connect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler when connected, before the source plays the connection's data.
  • on_disconnect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler when a connection whose on_connect callbacks ran ends.
  • on_error (of type (synchronous : bool, ((error) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on each connection or feeding failure.
  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_start (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler when source starts
  • on_stop (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler when source stops
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

Composition methods:

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source uses live composition by default.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source('a), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ({ending : source('a)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source('a)}) -> source('a)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

video.frei0r._3dflippo​

Frame rotation in 3d-space (by c.e. prelz AS FLUIDO <fluido(at)fluido.as>).

Type:

(?id : string?, ?center_position : {float}?, ?center_position : {float}?,
 ?don't_blank_mask : bool?, ?fill_with_image_or_black : bool?,
 ?invert_rotation_assignment : bool?, ?x_axis_rotation : {float}?,
 ?x_axis_rotation_rate : {float}?, ?y_axis_rotation : {float}?,
 ?y_axis_rotation_rate : {float}?, ?z_axis_rotation : {float}?,
 ?z_axis_rotation_rate : {float}?, source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)) ->
source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)

Composition:

This source inherits composition from its effective source.

Arguments:

  • id (of type string?, which defaults to null): Force the value of the source ID.
  • center_position (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Position of the center of rotation on the X axis.
  • center_position (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Position of the center of rotation on the Y axis.
  • don't_blank_mask (of type bool?, which defaults to null): Mask for frame transposition is not blanked, so a trace of old transpositions is maintained.
  • fill_with_image_or_black (of type bool?, which defaults to null): If true, pixels that are not transposed are black, otherwise, they are copied with the original.
  • invert_rotation_assignment (of type bool?, which defaults to null): If true, when mapping rotation, make inverted (wrong) assignment.
  • x_axis_rotation (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Rotation on the X axis.
  • x_axis_rotation_rate (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Rotation rate on the X axis.
  • y_axis_rotation (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Rotation on the Y axis.
  • y_axis_rotation_rate (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Rotation rate on the Y axis.
  • z_axis_rotation (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Rotation on the Z axis.
  • z_axis_rotation_rate (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Rotation rate on the Z axis.

This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. You should make sure that the source is available before calling this function and it should only be called inside synchronous streaming loop callback such as on_frame!
  • id (of type () -> string): Identifier of the source.
  • insert_metadata (of type (?override : bool, ?new_track : bool, [string * string]) -> unit): Dynamically insert metadata in a stream. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.
  • is_active (of type () -> bool): true if the source is active, i.e. it is continuously animated by its own clock whenever it is ready. Typically, true for outputs and sources such as input.http.
  • is_ready (of type () -> bool): Indicate if a source is ready to stream. This does not mean that the source is currently streaming, just that its resources are all properly initialized.
  • is_up (of type () -> bool): Indicate that the source can be asked to produce some data at any time. This is true when the source is currently being used or if it could be used at any time, typically inside a switch or fallback.
  • last_metadata (of type () -> [string * string]?): Return the last metadata from the source.
  • log (of type {level : (() -> int).{exchange : (int) -> int, set : (int) -> unit}}): Get or set the source's log level, from 1 to 5.
  • register_command (of type (?usage : string?, description : string, string, ((string) -> string)) -> unit): Register a server command for this source. Command is registered under the source's id namespace when it gets up and de-registered when it gets down.
  • remaining (of type () -> float): Estimation of remaining time in the current track.
  • reset_last_metadata_on_track (of type (() -> bool).{exchange : (bool) -> bool, set : (bool) -> unit}): If true, the source's last_metadata is reset on each new track. If a metadata is present along with the track mark, then it becomes the new last_metadata, otherwise, last_metadata becomes null`.
  • seek (of type (float) -> float): Seek forward, in seconds (returns the amount of time effectively seeked).
  • self_sync (of type () -> bool): Is the source currently controlling its own real-time loop.
  • self_sync_description (of type () -> string)
  • skip (of type () -> unit): Skip to the next track.
  • time (of type () -> float): Get a source's time, based on its assigned clock.

Callbacks:

  • on_collect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source is collected
  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

Composition methods:

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source inherits composition from its effective source.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

  • duration (of type () -> float): Estimation of the duration of the current track.
  • elapsed (of type () -> float): Elapsed time in the current track.
  • fallible (of type bool): Indicate if a source may fail, i.e. may not be ready to stream.
  • generate_frame (of type () -> unit): Generate a frame from the source without consuming it. This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. You should make sure that the source is available before calling this function and it should only be called inside synchronous streaming loop callback such as on_frame!
  • id (of type () -> string): Identifier of the source.
  • insert_metadata (of type (?override : bool, ?new_track : bool, [string * string]) -> unit): Dynamically insert metadata in a stream. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.
  • is_active (of type () -> bool): true if the source is active, i.e. it is continuously animated by its own clock whenever it is ready. Typically, true for outputs and sources such as input.http.
  • is_ready (of type () -> bool): Indicate if a source is ready to stream. This does not mean that the source is currently streaming, just that its resources are all properly initialized.
  • is_up (of type () -> bool): Indicate that the source can be asked to produce some data at any time. This is true when the source is currently being used or if it could be used at any time, typically inside a switch or fallback.
  • last_metadata (of type () -> [string * string]?): Return the last metadata from the source.
  • log (of type {level : (() -> int).{exchange : (int) -> int, set : (int) -> unit}}): Get or set the source's log level, from 1 to 5.
  • register_command (of type (?usage : string?, description : string, string, ((string) -> string)) -> unit): Register a server command for this source. Command is registered under the source's id namespace when it gets up and de-registered when it gets down.
  • remaining (of type () -> float): Estimation of remaining time in the current track.
  • reset_last_metadata_on_track (of type (() -> bool).{exchange : (bool) -> bool, set : (bool) -> unit}): If true, the source's last_metadata is reset on each new track. If a metadata is present along with the track mark, then it becomes the new last_metadata, otherwise, last_metadata becomes null`.
  • seek (of type (float) -> float): Seek forward, in seconds (returns the amount of time effectively seeked).
  • self_sync (of type () -> bool): Is the source currently controlling its own real-time loop.
  • self_sync_description (of type () -> string)
  • skip (of type () -> unit): Skip to the next track.
  • time (of type () -> float): Get a source's time, based on its assigned clock.

Callbacks:

  • on_collect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source is collected
  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

Composition methods:

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source inherits composition from its effective source.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

  • fallible (of type bool): Indicate if a source may fail, i.e. may not be ready to stream.
  • generate_frame (of type () -> unit): Generate a frame from the source without consuming it. This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. You should make sure that the source is available before calling this function and it should only be called inside synchronous streaming loop callback such as on_frame!
  • id (of type () -> string): Identifier of the source.
  • insert_metadata (of type (?override : bool, ?new_track : bool, [string * string]) -> unit): Dynamically insert metadata in a stream. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.
  • is_active (of type () -> bool): true if the source is active, i.e. it is continuously animated by its own clock whenever it is ready. Typically, true for outputs and sources such as input.http.
  • is_ready (of type () -> bool): Indicate if a source is ready to stream. This does not mean that the source is currently streaming, just that its resources are all properly initialized.
  • is_up (of type () -> bool): Indicate that the source can be asked to produce some data at any time. This is true when the source is currently being used or if it could be used at any time, typically inside a switch or fallback.
  • last_metadata (of type () -> [string * string]?): Return the last metadata from the source.
  • log (of type {level : (() -> int).{exchange : (int) -> int, set : (int) -> unit}}): Get or set the source's log level, from 1 to 5.
  • register_command (of type (?usage : string?, description : string, string, ((string) -> string)) -> unit): Register a server command for this source. Command is registered under the source's id namespace when it gets up and de-registered when it gets down.
  • remaining (of type () -> float): Estimation of remaining time in the current track.
  • reset_last_metadata_on_track (of type (() -> bool).{exchange : (bool) -> bool, set : (bool) -> unit}): If true, the source's last_metadata is reset on each new track. If a metadata is present along with the track mark, then it becomes the new last_metadata, otherwise, last_metadata becomes null`.
  • seek (of type (float) -> float): Seek forward, in seconds (returns the amount of time effectively seeked).
  • self_sync (of type () -> bool): Is the source currently controlling its own real-time loop.
  • self_sync_description (of type () -> string)
  • skip (of type () -> unit): Skip to the next track.
  • time (of type () -> float): Get a source's time, based on its assigned clock.

Callbacks:

  • on_collect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source is collected
  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

Composition methods:

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source inherits composition from its effective source.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

video.frei0r.burn​

Perform an RGB[A] dodge operation between the pixel sources, using the generalised algorithm: D = saturation of 255 or depletion of 0, of ((255 - A) * 256) / (B + 1) (by Jean-Sebastien Senecal).

This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.

  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source inherits composition from its effective source.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

  • elapsed (of type () -> float): Elapsed time in the current track.
  • fallible (of type bool): Indicate if a source may fail, i.e. may not be ready to stream.
  • generate_frame (of type () -> unit): Generate a frame from the source without consuming it. This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. You should make sure that the source is available before calling this function and it should only be called inside synchronous streaming loop callback such as on_frame!
  • id (of type () -> string): Identifier of the source.
  • insert_metadata (of type (?override : bool, ?new_track : bool, [string * string]) -> unit): Dynamically insert metadata in a stream. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.
  • is_active (of type () -> bool): true if the source is active, i.e. it is continuously animated by its own clock whenever it is ready. Typically, true for outputs and sources such as input.http.
  • is_ready (of type () -> bool): Indicate if a source is ready to stream. This does not mean that the source is currently streaming, just that its resources are all properly initialized.
  • is_up (of type () -> bool): Indicate that the source can be asked to produce some data at any time. This is true when the source is currently being used or if it could be used at any time, typically inside a switch or fallback.
  • last_metadata (of type () -> [string * string]?): Return the last metadata from the source.
  • log (of type {level : (() -> int).{exchange : (int) -> int, set : (int) -> unit}}): Get or set the source's log level, from 1 to 5.
  • register_command (of type (?usage : string?, description : string, string, ((string) -> string)) -> unit): Register a server command for this source. Command is registered under the source's id namespace when it gets up and de-registered when it gets down.
  • remaining (of type () -> float): Estimation of remaining time in the current track.
  • reset_last_metadata_on_track (of type (() -> bool).{exchange : (bool) -> bool, set : (bool) -> unit}): If true, the source's last_metadata is reset on each new track. If a metadata is present along with the track mark, then it becomes the new last_metadata, otherwise, last_metadata becomes null`.
  • seek (of type (float) -> float): Seek forward, in seconds (returns the amount of time effectively seeked).
  • self_sync (of type () -> bool): Is the source currently controlling its own real-time loop.
  • self_sync_description (of type () -> string)
  • skip (of type () -> unit): Skip to the next track.
  • time (of type () -> float): Get a source's time, based on its assigned clock.

Callbacks:

  • on_collect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source is collected
  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

Composition methods:

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source inherits composition from its effective source.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

  • callbacks_count (of type () -> [string * int]): Callbacks a script has registered on this source, as pairs of callback name and count. A count that keeps growing is a function registering on a source it is handed without releasing what it registered.
  • clear_last_metadata (of type () -> unit): Clear the last metadata from the source.
  • clock (of type clock): The source's clock
  • duration (of type () -> float): Estimation of the duration of the current track.
  • elapsed (of type () -> float): Elapsed time in the current track.
  • fallible (of type bool): Indicate if a source may fail, i.e. may not be ready to stream.
  • generate_frame (of type () -> unit): Generate a frame from the source without consuming it. This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. You should make sure that the source is available before calling this function and it should only be called inside synchronous streaming loop callback such as on_frame!
  • id (of type () -> string): Identifier of the source.
  • insert_metadata (of type (?override : bool, ?new_track : bool, [string * string]) -> unit): Dynamically insert metadata in a stream. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.
  • is_active (of type () -> bool): true if the source is active, i.e. it is continuously animated by its own clock whenever it is ready. Typically, true for outputs and sources such as input.http.
  • is_ready (of type () -> bool): Indicate if a source is ready to stream. This does not mean that the source is currently streaming, just that its resources are all properly initialized.
  • is_up (of type () -> bool): Indicate that the source can be asked to produce some data at any time. This is true when the source is currently being used or if it could be used at any time, typically inside a switch or fallback.
  • last_metadata (of type () -> [string * string]?): Return the last metadata from the source.
  • log (of type {level : (() -> int).{exchange : (int) -> int, set : (int) -> unit}}): Get or set the source's log level, from 1 to 5.
  • register_command (of type (?usage : string?, description : string, string, ((string) -> string)) -> unit): Register a server command for this source. Command is registered under the source's id namespace when it gets up and de-registered when it gets down.
  • remaining (of type () -> float): Estimation of remaining time in the current track.
  • reset_last_metadata_on_track (of type (() -> bool).{exchange : (bool) -> bool, set : (bool) -> unit}): If true, the source's last_metadata is reset on each new track. If a metadata is present along with the track mark, then it becomes the new last_metadata, otherwise, last_metadata becomes null`.
  • seek (of type (float) -> float): Seek forward, in seconds (returns the amount of time effectively seeked).
  • self_sync (of type () -> bool): Is the source currently controlling its own real-time loop.
  • self_sync_description (of type () -> string)
  • skip (of type () -> unit): Skip to the next track.
  • time (of type () -> float): Get a source's time, based on its assigned clock.

Callbacks:

  • on_collect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source is collected
  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

Composition methods:

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source inherits composition from its effective source.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

  • maximum_vertical_movement (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): The maximum distance the picture could move up or down. The larger the number the more the picture moves and the less subtle the effect..

  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed
  • on_shutdown (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source shuts down
  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks
  • on_wake_up (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called after the source is asked to get ready

Composition methods:

  • composition_type (of type (() -> string).{exchange : (string) -> string, set : (string) -> unit}): This source inherits composition from its effective source.
  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. video.frei0r.kaleid0sc0pe​

Applies a kaleid0sc0pe effect (by Brendan Hack).

Type:

(?id : string?, ?bg_alpha : {float}?, ?bg_color : int?,
 ?corner_search : bool?, ?edge_threshold : {float}?, ?multithreaded : bool?,
 ?n_threads : {float}?, ?origin_x : {float}?, ?origin_y : {float}?,
 ?preferred_corner : {float}?, ?reflect_edges : bool?,
 ?segmentation : {float}?, ?segmentation_direction : {float}?,
 ?source_segment : {float}?, ?specify_source : bool?,
 source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)

Composition:

This source inherits composition from its effective source.

Arguments:

  • id (of type string?, which defaults to null): Force the value of the source ID.
  • bg_alpha (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): alpha to use if reflection lies outside of source image and not reflecting back in. default 1.
  • bg_color (of type int?, which defaults to null): colour to use if reflection lies outside of source image and not reflecting back in. default 1,0,1.
  • corner_search (of type bool?, which defaults to null): if true search clockwise for furthest corner, otherwise counter clockwise.
  • edge_threshold (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): edge threshold / 4, reflections outside the image but within this distance clamp to the edge. default 0.
  • multithreaded (of type bool?, which defaults to null): set to true to enable multithreaded calculation. default true.
  • n_threads (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): the number of threads to use, if 0 then autocalculate otherwise value * 32. default 0.
  • origin_x (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): origin of the kaleid0sc0pe in x. default 0.5.
  • origin_y (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): origin of the kaleid0sc0pe in y. default 0.5.
  • preferred_corner (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): preferred corner, 0 is top right, 0.25 top left, 0.5 bottom left, 0.75 bottom right.
  • reflect_edges (of type bool?, which defaults to null): if true then reflections that end up outside the source reflect back into it, otherwise the specified background colour is used..
  • segmentation (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): kaleid0sc0pe segmentation / 128, segmentations of 1, 2 or multiples of 4 work best. default 16/128.
  • segmentation_direction (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): segmentation direction, < 1/3 is none, < 2/3 is counter clockwise, otherwise clockwise.
  • source_segment (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): centre of source segment if specify_source is true. 0 is in +x and rotates counter clockwise.
  • specify_source (of type bool?, which defaults to null): if true then source angle is read from source_segment, otherwise auto-calculated.
  • (unlabeled) (of type source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b))

video.frei0r.light_graffiti​

Creates light graffitis from a video by keeping the brightest spots (by Simon A. Eugster (Granjow)).

Type:

(?id : string?, ?backgroundweight : {float}?, ?blackreference : bool?,
 ?dim : {float}?, ?longalpha : {float}?, ?loweroverexposure : {float}?,
 ?nonlineardim : bool?, ?reset : bool?, ?saturation : {float}?,
 ?sensitivity : {float}?, ?statsbrightness : bool?, ?statsdifference : bool?,
 ?statsdiffsum : bool?, ?thresholdbrightness : {float}?,
 ?thresholddifference : {float}?, ?thresholddiffsum : {float}?,
 ?transparentbackground : bool?, source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)) ->
source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)

Composition:

This source inherits composition from its effective source.

Arguments:

  • id (of type string?, which defaults to null): Force the value of the source ID.
  • backgroundweight (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Describes how strong the (accumulated) background should shine through.
  • blackreference (of type bool?, which defaults to null): Uses black as background image instead of the first frame..
  • dim (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Dimming of the light mask.
  • longalpha (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Alpha value for moving average.
  • loweroverexposure (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Prevents some overexposure if the light source stays steady too long (varying speed).
  • nonlineardim (of type bool?, which defaults to null): Nonlinear dimming (may look more natural).
  • reset (of type bool?, which defaults to null): Reset filter masks.
  • saturation (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Saturation of lights.
  • sensitivity (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Sensitivity of the effect for light (higher sensitivity will lead to brighter lights).
  • statsbrightness (of type bool?, which defaults to null): Display the brightness and threshold, for adjusting the brightness threshold parameter.
  • statsdifference (of type bool?, which defaults to null): Display the background difference and threshold.
  • statsdiffsum (of type bool?, which defaults to null): Display the sum of the background difference and the threshold.
  • thresholdbrightness (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Brightness threshold to distinguish between foreground and background.
  • thresholddifference (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Threshold: Difference to background to distinguish between fore- and background.

  • vis_scale (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): A scaling factor to be applied to the visible component (divided by 10)..

Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.

Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

  • recheck (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): How often to detect an object in number of frames, divided by 1000.
  • scale (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Down scale the image prior detection.
  • search_scale (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): The search window scale factor, divided by 10.

  • smallest (of type {float}?, which defaults to null): Minimum window size in pixels, divided by 1000.

This can be useful in advanced cases where generating a frame is required to trigger some side effect like calculating some metadata before making a decision. You should make sure that the source is available before calling this function and it should only be called inside synchronous streaming loop callback such as on_frame!

  • insert_metadata (of type (?override : bool, ?new_track : bool, [string * string]) -> unit): Dynamically insert metadata in a stream. Inserts a new track with the given metadata if new_track is true. When override is false, metadata that the source provides itself takes precedence over the inserted one.

  • last_metadata (of type () -> [string * string]?): Return the last metadata from the source.
  • log (of type {level : (() -> int).{exchange : (int) -> int, set : (int) -> unit}}): Get or set the source's log level, from 1 to 5.
  • register_command (of type (?usage : string?, description : string, string, ((string) -> string)) -> unit): Register a server command for this source. Command is registered under the source's id namespace when it gets up and de-registered when it gets down.

  • reset_last_metadata_on_track (of type (() -> bool).{exchange : (bool) -> bool, set : (bool) -> unit}): If true, the source's last_metadata is reset on each new track. If a metadata is present along with the track mark, then it becomes the new last_metadata, otherwise, last_metadata becomes null`.
  • seek (of type (float) -> float): Seek forward, in seconds (returns the amount of time effectively seeked).
  • self_sync (of type () -> bool): Is the source currently controlling its own real-time loop.
  • self_sync_description (of type () -> string)
  • skip (of type () -> unit): Skip to the next track.
  • time (of type () -> float): Get a source's time, based on its assigned clock.

Callbacks:

  • on_collect (of type (synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to be called when source is collected
  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes. This is useful to track frame content changes through the streaming pipeline. The before callback is called before computing the frame with the checksum of the cached frame (if any, null otherwise). The main callback is called after computing the frame with the checksum of the generated frame and the remaining cache (if any).
  • on_metadata (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler to execute on each metadata
  • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position. If remaining is false, callback is executed when position in track is more or equal to position. If remaining is true, callback is executed when remaining time in the current track is less or equal to position. Keep in mind that elapsed time is exact while remaining time is always estimated. Remaining time is usually more accurate for file-based sources. When allow_partial is true, if the current track ends before the offset position is reached, callback is still executed

  • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks

  • on_leave (of type ({source : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b), track_sensitive : bool}) -> unit): Called after switching away from this source in a switch operator, once the transition using the ending source has completed. Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

  • on_frame (of type (?before : bool, synchronous : bool, (() -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on frame. When before is true, callback is executed before computing the frame and after otherwise
  • on_frame_checksum (of type (?before : ((string?) -> unit)?, synchronous : bool, ((cache : string?, string) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler Register callbacks to compute frame checksums for debugging purposes.   • on_position (of type (position : {float}, ?remaining : bool, ?allow_partial : bool, synchronous : bool, ((float, [string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track position.   • on_track (of type (synchronous : bool, (([string * string]) -> unit)) -> {release : () -> unit}): Call a given handler on track marks

Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). This function must return quickly as it runs in the streaming thread. The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
  • on_select (of type ( { ending : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)?, replay_metadata : bool, starting : source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b) }) -> source(video=yuv420p('a), 'b)): Called when selecting this source in a switch operator. Receives a record with starting (the incoming source) and ending (the previous source, or null when the ending source reached a track boundary). Returns the source to use. By default, both file and live profiles fade out ending when non-null (up to 1 second). The default is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • replay_metadata (of type {bool}): Whether to replay the latest metadata on this source when it is selected in a switch operator. Defaults to true. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).
  • single (of type bool): Forbid the selection of this source for two consecutive tracks in switch operators. Defaults to false.
  • track_sensitive (of type {bool}): Whether this source insists on track boundaries in switch operators: when true, it prefers not to be interrupted mid-track and not to be started mid-track. A switch may only cut into a track that is still playing when at least one of the two sources involved has track_sensitive set to false; otherwise it waits for the playing source to reach a track boundary. File-based sources default to true; live network and hardware inputs default to false. The value is looked up at runtime from the active composition profile (source.composition.file or source.composition.live depending on composition_type).

Receives a record with source (the source being left) and track_sensitive (true if the ending source's last frame had a track mark, i.e. it finished naturally; false if it was preempted mid-track). The default depends on the active composition profile: file sources (source.composition.file) skip the source when preempted mid-track so it starts fresh on its next selection, and do nothing when it finished naturally; live sources (source.composition.live) do nothing.
